planner.pageLead: Pick the week's dishes; they spread across the days and the grammes adjust themselves.
planner.targetsDefault: The menu's reference targets. Sign in to compose against your own.
planner.fillWeek: Copy this day across the week

day.impossibleHint: These dishes cannot make the day, however the portions are scaled. Swap one of them.

saving.signedOut: Sign in to find it again on your phone.
saving.nothingToSave: Nothing new to save just yet.
saving.failed: Saving did not go through. Try again in a moment.

groupHint.main: They rotate at noon and in the evening, never twice in a day.
groupHint.snack: Two snacks rotating across the afternoon: pick at least two.

planner.spreadHint: The dishes rotate from day to day, then the portions adjust to your targets.
planner.spreadBlocked: Pick at least one dish for lunch and dinner.

detail.reference: Reference portion: it will be adjusted to your targets.

swap.fixes: One swap is enough to bring this day on target
swap.closer: No swap is enough, but this one gets closer

balance.hint: The marked dishes go best with what you have already chosen
balance.enoughHint: You may add more, but nothing is missing.
balance.unfinished: Some meals are still to choose
balance.unfinishedHint: the figures will rise as you add them

fix.title: Swap a dish to fix it
fix.none: No swap fixes this one. Add another dish to your selection instead.

planner.completeHint: Fills the minimum with the dishes that fit your targets best. You can change any of them.

generate.hint: Fills the choices for variety and the targets, spreads them across the days, then mends them — in one click. Locked dishes never move.

preferences.title: Composing preferences
preferences.lead: They steer the suggestions and the one-click generation. You can always pick something else by hand.
preferences.weeklyBudgetHint: The generator prefers cheaper dishes to stay under it, without breaking the balance.
preferences.varietyWindowHint: A recent dish stays possible if nothing else fits better, but variety is preferred.

household.title: Who this week works out for
household.lead: Portions adapt to each person. A note here means the chosen dishes cannot suit everyone at once.
